title: Agent-based capacity-market control configuration
description: Configuration for the operational-optimization market controller: agents price their stress on normalized [0,1] cost curves, and per-route PIDs throttle structures on the buyer-minus-seller cost differential.

output_dir.description: User-reviewable folder for config, logs, figures, and report.

treatment_tag.description: Node tag marking treatment-connected outfalls; all other outfalls are uncontrolled.

control_interval_seconds.description: How often prices are recomputed and settings reapplied; a multiple of the routing step.

currency_note.description: Free text documenting the single normalized currency so cross-commodity prices are comparable.

objectives.description: Relative weights for the four (minimized) objectives; used only for tuning/scoring, not for the reactive loop itself.

cost_curves.description: Named, reusable curves mapping a stress metric in [0,1] to a price in [0,1].

onset.description: Metric value below which price stays at floor (PL) / curve midpoint (logistic).

full.description: piecewise_linear only: metric value at which price reaches ceiling.

steepness.description: logistic only: slope of the sigmoid.

id.description: Model element ID (node or link), resolved via the query_* tools.

role.description: Role is usually state-dependent; 'both' lets the agent switch by its live stress.

stress_metric.description: Which normalized [0,1] state quantity prices this agent.

trade_routes.description: Each controllable structure mediates one buyer/seller trade and is throttled by its own PID.

buyer_agents.description: Agent IDs whose stress sets the buyer price (aggregated, e.g. max).

seller_agents.description: Agent IDs whose spare capacity sets the seller price.

aggregate.description: How to combine multiple agents into one side price.

setpoint.description: Target cost differential; 0 drives prices to equilibrium.

constraints.description: Global hard limits enforced regardless of price; a violating result is invalid.

max_hgl_freeboard.description: Minimum allowed freeboard to rim before a setting is rejected.
